                          Data & Storage
                          Storage used (Cloud Firestore)
                          Calculating…

                          Everything is saved automatically to the cloud — no action needed, and it's there the moment you open the dashboard, on any device.

                          Recover Batch Explorer data: the app keeps automatic restore points. If per-batch data (participants, assessments, schedules, final employees) is missing, this finds the most recent restore point that still has it and puts it back. Batches that already have data are left untouched.

                          Not checked yet.

                          Troubleshooting: if something looks wrong (blank charts, stuck data), this clears the shared cloud database — for everyone viewing this dashboard — and reloads with the original 22-batch sample data — a clean known-good state to test from. Back up first if you have real data you want to keep.
